queries.name: system
queries.query: MATCH (s:System) WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:owns]-(o:Person) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT o {.name, .role, .is_active, .leave_date}) AS owners OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:about_system]-(d:Decision) WITH s, owners, count(DISTINCT d) AS decisions OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:mentions]-(t:Ticket) WITH s, owners, decisions, count(DISTINCT t) AS tickets OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:owns|about_system]-(x) OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:decided_by*0..1]->(:Person)-[:member_of|leads]->(team:Team) RETURN s.name, s.system_type, s.vendor, owners, decisions, tickets, collect(DISTINCT team.name)

queries.name: system_decisions
queries.query: MATCH (s:System)<-[:about_system]-(d:Decision) WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:decided_by]->(p:Person) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT p.name) AS deciders OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:about_system]->(s2:System) RETURN d.id, d.title, d.decided_on, deciders, collect(DISTINCT s2.name) ORDER BY d.decided_on

queries.name: system_people
